qualification_exclusions.reason: Six compound criteria not all established, especially no hidden intermediate continuity. Not excluded by alleged impossibility of every partial-order compound.

Generation lifecycle safeguard retained in full; not a certified target alternative merely because tombstones mention retired credentials. This is not a proof T7 could never receive later explicit semantic authority.
Recognition must not be promoted to the physical event recognized.
Do not equate evidence availability with physical or credential transition.
Neither endpoint is ACTIVE; confinement does not itself establish O8 on both sides or a credential admission/succession event.

Treating delivery as O8 succession would require an additional bridge from custody/delivery to protected-object scope; no automatic custody/material membership. Allowed delivery alone is not harmful inheritance.
Participant lifecycle, not credential identity. Reclassifying by birth alone would collapse principal identity into credential identity.
Knowledge-state resolution must not be selected as physical credential inheritance by receipt existence.

minimality_claim: Smallest set obtainable from these qualified source boundaries by the required proof-based domination rule: no pair has a proven strict domination relation. This is evidence-relative retention, not a proof of six necessary eventual semantic transitions.
counterexample_to_one_candidate_reductio: T8 ledger succession does not express same-generation registry enrollment or entry/exit of ACTIVE; those do not themselves perform high-water succession. Choosing T8 by convenience would discard distinct comparison capability and prejudge substitution.
